assessments.reasoning: The report introduction ties the Interlisp-D implementation to running the Interlisp system software. Its Overview and Status abstract likewise states the direction from the Dolphin/Dorado implementation to the underlying programming system.

challenge.method: Test reversed relationship, identity equivalence or a distinct source-language dialect, and whether the documented AltoLisp lineage implies VAX or Medley compatibility.
challenge.results: The abstract and background distinguish the Interlisp language, the Alto precursor and the target implementation. That supports the directional implemented-by edge only. Shared lineage, a VM refinement and a report of supported applications establish no unscoped compatibility proposition.

limitations: The edge is source-documented for the specified report. Later products, all environments, and language-implementation conformance are outside this reviewed relationship.
